Naga Films Studio’s Motion & VFX handoff can use **EffectCraft** as an external desktop tool.

- Upstream: https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE`)

(`media/` + `naga-motion-project.json`) for manual import in EffectCraft desktop.

Product UI branding in Naga Films is **Motion & VFX** only. Do not use ArtCraft trademarks in Naga UI.
